rows.obj:
First pairing
Entry: any page that requires thumbprint (e.g. STMS Step 1 Seller)
rows.pre:
Iris reader on, not paired
Bluetooth on
rows.steps:
1. Open any page that requires thumbprint
2. Pair the Iris reader when the app asks
3. Tap **Allow** on the Bluetooth permission
rows.exp:
- ++Reader paired and connected++
- **[Scan IC]** enabled
rows.rem: Button names follow the web new design ([Scan IC], [Reconnect], [Cancel]). Confirm in app.

rows.pre:
Iris reader on, not paired
Fresh install
rows.steps:
1. Open any page that requires thumbprint
2. Tap **Don't allow** on the Bluetooth permission
rows.exp:
- App shows a message asking for Bluetooth permission
- !!No crash or freeze!!
rows.rem: Exact message TBC.

rows.pre:
Iris reader paired
Phone Bluetooth off
rows.steps: 1. Open any page that requires thumbprint
rows.exp:
- App shows a message to turn on Bluetooth
- **[Reconnect]** enabled
rows.rem: Exact message TBC.

rows.steps: 1. Open any page that requires thumbprint
rows.exp:
- App shows a no-device message
- **[Reconnect]** enabled
rows.rem: Exact message TBC. Web Dermalog reference: "Please plug in Dermalog Biometric Device and click [Reconnect]".

rows.steps:
1. Unpair the Iris reader in phone Bluetooth settings
2. Open any page that requires thumbprint
rows.exp:
- App shows a message to pair the reader
- !!No crash or freeze!!
rows.rem: Device & Test Scope R44: "Unpair the scanner and check the message the app shows."

rows.steps:
1. Open any page that requires thumbprint
2. Cut the connection, then tap **[Scan IC]**
Repeat step 2 with:
a) Bluetooth off
b) Out of range
c) Reader off
rows.exp:
- App shows a connection-lost message
- **[Reconnect]** enabled
- !!No crash or freeze!!
rows.rem: Exact message TBC.

rows.steps:
1. Insert MyKad, tap **[Scan IC]**
2. While reading, cut the connection (a/b/c as TS06)
rows.exp:
- App shows an error message
- User can rescan after reconnect
- !!No crash or freeze!!
rows.rem: Exact message TBC. Web reference: "Unable to read photo. Please try again."

rows.steps:
1. Scan MyKad until details show
2. Before thumbprint, cut the connection (a/b/c as TS06)
rows.exp:
- App shows a connection-lost message
- **[Reconnect]** enabled
- !!No crash or freeze!!
rows.rem: Exact message TBC.

rows.steps:
1. Scan MyKad
2. Place thumb
3. While capturing, cut the connection (a/b/c as TS06)
rows.exp:
- App shows an error message
- User can redo thumbprint after reconnect
- !!No crash or freeze!!
rows.rem: Exact message TBC.

rows.steps:
1. Complete MyKad + thumbprint until **Verification Passed**
2. Cut the connection (a/b/c as TS06)
3. Tap **[Next]**
rows.exp:
- Note whether the verified result is kept or a rescan is asked
- !!No crash or freeze!!
rows.rem: Expected behaviour TBC with dev.

rows.steps:
1. Restore the connection (Bluetooth on / back in range / reader on)
2. Tap **[Reconnect]**
3. Scan MyKad and thumbprint
rows.exp:
- ++Reader connected++
- ++Verification Passed++

rows.steps:
1. Turn Bluetooth off and on 5 times quickly
2. Tap **[Reconnect]**, scan MyKad
rows.exp:
- ++Reader connects and reads MyKad++
- !!No crash or freeze!!

rows.pre:
Iris reader connected
Valid MyKad A (seller) and B (buyer)
rows.steps:
1. Start an STMS transaction
2. Step 1: scan MyKad A, place thumb
3. Step 3: scan MyKad B, place thumb
4. Complete the transaction
5. Check the record on web UCD and BO listing
rows.exp:
- ++Verification Passed++ at Step 1 and Step 3
- ++Transaction completed++
- Record shows on web listing
rows.rem: Device & Test Scope R41: "Capture a thumbprint and complete one transaction."

rows.steps: 1. Tap **[Scan IC]** without a card
rows.exp:
- App shows a no-card message
- **[Scan IC]** enabled to retry
rows.rem: Exact message TBC. Web reference: "No card is detected. Please insert IC and click [Scan IC] to try again."

rows.pre:
Iris reader connected
Invalid or damaged MyKad
rows.steps: 1. Insert the card, tap **[Scan IC]**
rows.exp:
- App shows a read-error message
- !!No details filled!!
rows.rem: Exact message TBC. Web reference: "Please ensure the IC is placed properly or the chip surface is cleaned"

rows.pre:
Iris reader connected
Chip card that is not MyKad
rows.steps: 1. Insert the card, tap **[Scan IC]**
rows.exp:
- App shows a read-error message
- !!No details filled!!
rows.rem: Exact message TBC.

rows.steps:
1. Insert MyKad, tap **[Scan IC]**
2. Remove the card while reading
rows.exp:
- App shows an error message
- User can rescan
rows.rem: Exact message TBC.

rows.steps:
1. Scan MyKad
2. Place a thumb that does not match the card
rows.exp:
- !!Verification failed!!
- User can retry
rows.rem: Exact message TBC. Web reference: "Verification failed. Please click on [Scan IC] to try again"

rows.steps:
1. Scan MyKad
2. Fail the thumbprint 3 times in a row
3. Retry with the correct thumb
rows.exp:
- Each failure shows a message
- ++Correct thumb passes after retries++
rows.rem: Retry limit TBC.

rows.steps:
1. Scan MyKad
2. Remove the card
3. Place thumb
rows.exp:
- App shows a message to insert the card
- !!Verification not passed!!
rows.rem: Exact message TBC.

rows.steps:
1. Tap the in-app **Back**
2. Return to the same step
rows.exp: - Note whether the verified result is kept or a rescan is asked
rows.rem: Adapted from 7229 "refresh page". Expected TBC with dev.

rows.pre:
Two Iris readers on
One paired to this phone
rows.steps:
1. Open any page that requires thumbprint
2. Scan MyKad on the paired reader
rows.exp: - ++App uses the paired reader only++

rows.pre:
Android 13-15 phone
Iris paired + Dermalog on OTG
rows.steps:
1. Open any page that requires thumbprint
2. Scan MyKad
rows.exp:
- Note which reader the app uses
- !!No crash or freeze!!
rows.rem: Expected TBC with dev. Not on iOS / Android 16+ (no Dermalog).

rows.steps:
1. Tap **[Cancel]** during MyKad read
2. Repeat during thumbprint
rows.exp:
- Scan stops
- User can start again with **[Scan IC]**

rows.steps:
1. Tap **[Scan IC]** 5 times quickly
2. Repeat with **[Reconnect]** and **[Cancel]**
rows.exp:
- One action only
- !!No crash or freeze!!

rows.steps:
1. Press **Home**, reopen the app
2. Repeat with **Overview** + switch app
3. Repeat with lock and unlock
rows.exp: - Remain on the same page - Auto refresh the page, need to rescan MyKad & redo thumbprint
rows.rem: Expected copied from Phase 2 P2 - Compatibility Test, STMSAPP_COMPATIBILITY_TS2.

rows.steps:
1. Receive a call, end it
2. Receive a notification
rows.exp:
- Remain on the page
- Note whether a rescan is asked
rows.rem: Phase 2 rule is for normal screens. Thumbprint-step result TBC.

rows.steps:
1. Kill the app from Overview
2. Reopen
rows.exp: - Launch from Homepage
rows.rem: Phase 2 STMSAPP_COMPATIBILITY_TS2.

rows.steps:
1. Turn off Wi-Fi and mobile data
2. Scan MyKad and thumbprint
rows.exp: - Will show toast message, "No internet connection"
rows.rem: Phase 2 Functional & Interruption Test R78.

rows.pre:
Galaxy Tab Active4 Pro
Iris reader connected
rows.steps:
1. Scan MyKad
2. Rotate the tablet
3. Place thumb
rows.exp:
- Data is still there
- ++Verification Passed++
rows.rem: Device & Test Scope R50: "Rotate the tablet in the middle of a flow and check that the data is still there".

rows.steps:
1. Time each, 5 readings:
a) Reader connect
b) MyKad read
c) Thumbprint
d) Next step load
2. Record the average in Remarks
rows.exp: - Timings recorded
rows.rem: Adapted from 7229 Performance TS.

rows.steps:
1. Pair the scanner and allow the Bluetooth permission.
2. Capture a thumbprint and complete one transaction.
3. Turn Bluetooth off and on, then scan again.
4. Move out of range and come back, then scan again.
5. Unpair the scanner and check the message the app shows.
rows.exp:
- ++Each step works++
- !!No crash or freeze!!
rows.rem: Steps verbatim from Device & Test Scope R38-R44. Use the Short-check devices columns.
